description: This file provides portability and system abstraction functions for different operating systems, including Windows, Linux, and macOS. It includes platform-specific implementations for sleep functions, call stack backtracing, and network address conversions, as well as utility functions for string formatting.

methods.name: inet_aton
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address from the dotted-decimal string format to a network address structure, with platform-specific implementation for Windows.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds on Windows, using a waitable timer.

methods.name: mremap
methods.description: Stub function for remapping memory on macOS, currently returns nullptr.

methods.name: clock_gettime
methods.description: Stub function for getting the current time on macOS, currently returns 0.

methods.name: SleepMs
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of milliseconds on Linux.

methods.name: SleepUs
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds on Linux.

methods.name: htonll
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer from host to network byte order, with endianness check.

methods.name: ntohll
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer from network to host byte order, with endianness check.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments into a std::string.
